The shelf says one number. The count sheet says another. Someone signs off anyway. That's how we used to handle work orders at Meridian Facilities Group until Slatebridge came in.

With 120 technicians spread across three cities, our operations were always a bit of a mess. Now, overtime hours are down 18% thanks to automatic job assignment by skill and location. SLA compliance has jumped from 87% to 96%, and dispatchers no longer use the whiteboard at all—replaced with Slatebridge's dispatcher board.

Our ops director says, "I used to spend my mornings untangling the schedule. Now I spend them on customers." 

If you're managing a commercial maintenance operation, imagine running your business without those morning headaches. Give Slatebridge a try and see how it can streamline your dispatch process.
